findings.issue_identified: In protocol v1.0, the STRIPED mask generator contained a duty-cycle clamping bug (min(dose * 2, 1.0) * stripe_h) which restricted occluded stripe height to at most 1.0 * stripe_h (half the period 2 * stripe_h). Consequently, for requested doses >= 0.50, achieved dose plateaued at 0.50 across all images. This created zero common support between STRIPED and the other three topologies (CENTER, OUTER_RING, RANDOM_PATCH) for doses in [0.55, 0.75].
findings.resolution: Redesigned STRIPED geometry to pixel-exact adaptive allocation: k_total = round(dose * H) rows occluded, partitioned across min(5, max(1, H // 4)) stripe periods. Verified: mean dose error drops from 0.0586 to 0.0081, max error drops from 0.3667 to 0.0333. Full common support [0.00, 0.75] established across all 4 topologies.

common_support_audit.verdict: FAIR COMMON SUPPORT CONFIRMED — proceed to execution.
